title: ActionRequest
description: A single structured browser action returned by the server. The extension's client action validator must check every field before executing anything — see extension/src/action/validator.ts.

element_id.description: Required for click / type / type_secret. Must match an element_id from the most recent SanitizedContext.

value.description: Literal text for 'type' or a key name for 'keypress'. Never used for secrets.

value_ref.description: Local secret reference for 'type_secret'. The real value is resolved inside the extension and never appears in this payload.

amount.description: Scroll distance in px, or wait duration in ms.

task_id.description: Must match the task_id the extension sent in SanitizedContext — mismatched task/session is rejected.

tab_id.description: Optional tab identifier. Supplied by the server when it targets a specific browser tab. The extension may use this for routing but is not required to. If absent or null, the action applies to the current active tab.
